differences.a_observable: Strong vignette with darker corners compared to the center.
differences.b_observable: Flat lighting across the frame with almost no corner falloff.
differences.fix: Add a vignette in post-production or adjust the light falloff.

differences.a_observable: Shallow depth of field blurs the background elements.
differences.b_observable: Deep depth of field keeps the entire scene in sharp focus.
differences.fix: Enable depth of field on the camera and adjust the aperture.

differences.a_observable: The 'Secure Payments' tile is positioned closer to the yellow 'Recurly' tile.
differences.b_observable: The 'Secure Payments' tile is spaced further away, leaving more empty space.
differences.fix: Adjust the spacing and positions of the tiles to match.

differences.a_observable: The white surfaces have a warm, cream-colored tint.
differences.b_observable: The white surfaces are neutral white/grey.
differences.fix: Adjust the white balance or color grading to add a warm tint.

json.highest_impact_fix: Enable depth of field on the camera and adjust the aperture to match the reference blur.
